passages.text: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nHe gave it to the choirmaster.\r\nHe said to use the Gittith style.

passages.text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth! You have set Your glory above the heavens.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
He wrote it to be sung with the Gittith.
The LORD is our Lord.
The LORD’s name is majestic in all the earth.
The LORD set His glory above the heavens.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ עַֽל־ הַגִּתִּ֗ית מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יְהוָ֤ה אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מָֽה־ אַדִּ֣יר שִׁ֭מְךָ בְּכָל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּנָ֥ה ה֝וֹדְךָ֗ עַל־ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord.
God gives strength through the words of children and infants.
God does this because He has enemies.
God uses the praise of children and infants to stop His enemies.
God silences those who oppose Him and seek revenge.
passages.original: מִפִּ֤י עֽוֹלְלִ֨ים׀ וְֽיֹנְקִים֮ יִסַּ֪דְתָּ֫ עֹ֥ז לְמַ֥עַן צוֹרְרֶ֑יךָ לְהַשְׁבִּ֥ית א֝וֹיֵ֗ב וּמִתְנַקֵּֽם׃

passages.text: When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers, the moon and the stars, which You have set in place— what is man that You are mindful of him, or the son of man that You care for him?
passages.sermon:
God made the heavens.
God used His fingers to create them.
God set the moon in its place.
God set the stars in their places.
I look at the heavens.
I see the work of God’s hands.
I ask, “What is man?”
I ask, “Why do You remember man?”
I ask, “What is the son of man?”
I ask, “Why do You care for him?”
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אֶרְאֶ֣ה שָׁ֭מֶיךָ מַעֲשֵׂ֣י אֶצְבְּעֹתֶ֑יךָ יָרֵ֥חַ וְ֝כוֹכָבִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר כּוֹנָֽנְתָּה׃ מָֽה־ אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן־ אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: You made him a little lower than the angels; You crowned him with glory and honor.
passages.sermon:
God created man.
God made man a little lower than the angels.
God crowned man with glory.
God crowned man with honor.
passages.original: וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃

passages.text: You made him ruler of the works of Your hands; You have placed everything under his feet: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field, the birds of the air and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.
passages.sermon:
God made man ruler over the works of His hands.
God placed everything under man's feet.
God placed all sheep under man's authority.
God placed all oxen under man's authority.
God placed the beasts of the field under man's authority.
God placed the birds of the air under man's authority.
God placed the fish of the sea under man's authority.
God placed all that swim the paths of the seas under man's authority.
passages.original: תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־ רַגְלָֽיו׃ צֹנֶ֣ה וַאֲלָפִ֣ים כֻּלָּ֑ם וְ֝גַ֗ם בַּהֲמ֥וֹת שָׂדָֽי׃ צִפּ֣וֹר שָׁ֭מַיִם וּדְגֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם עֹ֝בֵ֗ר אָרְח֥וֹת יַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is our Lord.
The LORD rules over all.
The LORD’s name is majestic.
The LORD’s name is great in all the earth.
passages.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֲדֹנֵ֑ינוּ מָֽה־ אַדִּ֥יר שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ בְּכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
